↻ Update career stats from Livesport
How it works: this page is a static GitHub Pages file, so it cannot reliably fetch livesport.cz directly from the browser. The Update careers workflow prepares the full player database for ChatGPT, ChatGPT checks the Livesport links, and you import the returned JSON back here.

1) Click Export update request and attach the JSON together with this HTML when asking ChatGPT to update careers.
2) ChatGPT checks Kariéra → Liga only, compares the new totals with existing career rows, and returns update JSON.
3) Paste the update JSON below and click Import updated careers. Existing season rows are updated, new season/team rows are added, and match-form data is not touched.
